config.amendment: docs/SPEC.md, D11 canonical amendment (owner, 2026-09-12), the owner rationale recorded with it and the nine Fable addenda
config.label: RECENT-ACTIVITY ADMISSION, SENSORY CONTEXT V2 AND THE REINFORCEMENT SCALE
config.d11_runs_no_neural_experiment: D11 is design, implementation and focused tests. It starts no historical and no live market-neural run, collects no new RPC data, exercises nothing live, searches no parameter, does no visual work and touches no real money. The only numbers it computes are the reward calibration, the two fitted feature scales and the retrospective admission/encoder diagnostic, all from artifacts that already exist on disk.
preserved_from_d10_unchanged: k = 8, gain 0.1, 100 steps, 20 ms presentation window
decoder populations, signs, baseline and thresholds
the biological plasticity mechanism and the learning rate
normalised episode-specific credit assignment, one update per settled outcome
exact integer curve quoting, the three curve costs, gas and the accounting identities
the fixed 900-second horizon and the 0.01 ETH position size
collector budgets, recovery, the observer contracts and the upstream audit
cadence 30 s, at most 6 candidates per round, one open position, long only
round-robin rotation, blind to price, volume, flow, outcome and ticker
REINFORCE_CAP = 1.0, the signed normalisation and clipping mechanism, neutral treatment and the eligibility rules

admission.v1_is_untouched: flytrade/pons/admission.py keeps admission_v1 byte-identical so every D10 log, test and the determinism check keep reproducing
admission.constants_are_an_engineering_choice: these three numbers are a declared initial engineering default, not a discovery about which tokens profit. They are registered here before any D11 number is computed and are not searched, tuned or revisited after a run is observed.
admission.valid_trade: a CurveBuy or CurveSell event with a nonzero quote leg and a nonzero token leg, deduplicated by log id, with orphaned and removed logs excluded. Creation, liquidity configuration, CurveCompleted and duplicated log lines are not trades. A snipe-tax exemption is not a trade and a snipe-taxed buy is an ordinary trade. The same definition is used by pons_context_v2 for trade_count_2m, gross_volume_2m, flow_imb_2m, rv_2m and since_last_trade.
rule_for_a_new_entry: every admission_v1 condition EXCEPT its '>= 3 trades ever': deployment pons-v2, quote asset native ETH, curve not completed at the cutoff, reconstructed state valid (sellableTokens > 0 and realQuoteReserve > 0), the 0.01 ETH paper buy does not exhaust the curve, age >= 60 s, and in replay cutoff + latency + horizon inside the token's coverage
AND at the cutoff: at least minimum_valid_trades_in_window valid trades inside (cutoff - recent_window_seconds, cutoff]
AND the last valid trade at most maximum_seconds_since_last_trade before the cutoff
admission.evaluated_against: the canonical market-information cutoff, using only successfully decoded events available at that cutoff. No future event enters an admission decision.
admission.not_a_classifier: these are recent-activity filters. They are not an organic-flow, anti-manipulation or profitability classifier and must never be reported as one.
admission.reversible: admission is evaluated fresh at every tick from the tape as it stands, so an inactive candidate returns the moment new qualifying activity appears. Nothing is remembered between ticks except the rotation counter.

reason_codes.INACTIVE: the tape is complete at this cutoff and the recency rule fails: fewer than 2 valid trades in the window, or the last valid trade more than 60 s back
reason_codes.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: age < 60 s, or the cutoff precedes the launch, or the tape is too short to answer
reason_codes.COLLECTOR_LAG: the observation's confirmed/fast block is more than 2 ticks (60 s) behind the cutoff clock. Replay: never, by construction
reason_codes.QUOTE_UNSUPPORTED: the quote asset is not native ETH
reason_codes.ROUTE_COMPLETED: the curve completed onto the unsupported post-graduation route at or before the cutoff
reason_codes.STATE_INVALID: the reconstructed state fails its own arithmetic, or sellableTokens <= 0, or realQuoteReserve <= 0
reason_codes.COVERAGE: replay only: cutoff + latency + horizon lies outside the token's coverage
reason_codes.CURVE_EXHAUSTED: the 0.01 ETH paper buy would exhaust the curve (a refund, or tokens_out >= sellableTokens)
reason_codes.DEPLOYMENT_UNSUPPORTED: carried unchanged from admission_v1: the deployment is not the supported pons-v2 curve route. DECLARED ADDITION to the eight codes the addendum names, because dropping it would either admit a v1-factory curve or mislabel it as QUOTE_UNSUPPORTED
reason_codes.ROTATED: carried unchanged from admission_v1: admitted, but not presented this round by the round-robin

admission.collector_lag_is_not_inactivity: a COLLECTOR_LAG on the whole tracked set marks the round DATA_LAG. A collector outage can never be reported as every token becoming inactive.

round_statuses.NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATES: no tracked token qualified at this cutoff. No presentation happens and nothing is relaxed to force a decision
round_statuses.DATA_LAG: every considered token was excluded by COLLECTOR_LAG

admission.never_relaxed: the criteria are never relaxed automatically to force a decision, and fewer than six candidates are used when fewer qualify.
admission.controls_new_entries_only: a held position is observed, marked and settled at its own horizon regardless of whether its token still satisfies admission. Admission gates entries, never exits.
admission.rotation: unchanged from admission_v1, round-robin and blind to every price

features.causal: every feature is computed from tape points at or before the cutoff and from nothing after it
features.windows_clipped_to_launch: as in D10: ret_w = log(p(cutoff) / p(max(cutoff - w, launch))) and drawdown_5m maxes from max(cutoff - 5 min, launch). A window that starts before the launch is measured from the launch, never zeroed.

definitions.since_last_trade: seconds since the last VALID trade at or before the cutoff; when the token has never traded it is the age, which is the same clipped-to-launch convention every windowed feature uses. It is a sensory input only and is never fed to a reward or output neuron
definitions.ret_30s: log change of the marginal curve price over 30 s
definitions.flow_imb_2m: (buy quote in - sell quote out) / (their sum) over the valid trades of the last 120 s, in [-1, 1]; 0 when the window is empty
definitions.trade_count_2m: the number of VALID trades inside (cutoff - 120 s, cutoff]. It replaces D10's trade_rate_2m, which was the same count divided by the window in minutes
definitions.gross_volume_2m: the sum of |curve-side quote delta| over the valid trades of the last 120 s, in ETH: a buy contributes its net quote into the curve (quoteIn - fee - tax) and a sell its gross quote out of the curve (quoteOut + fee + tax). This is the GROSS traded volume, the absolute sum, against flow_imb_2m's signed one; the per-leg convention is the same signed quantity TokenTape.apply stores as flow
definitions.rv_2m: SD of per-trade log marginal-price changes over the valid trades of the last 120 s
definitions.drawdown_5m: log distance below the 5-minute maximum marginal price, <= 0

the_four_owner_distinctions.A_no_trades_in_the_observed_interval: trade_count_2m = 0 and gross_volume_2m = 0 with since_last_trade large
the_four_owner_distinctions.B_many_trades_and_almost_no_net_price_ch: trade_count_2m and gross_volume_2m high, ret_30s / ret_2m / ret_5m near 0, rv_2m small
the_four_owner_distinctions.D_missing_or_incomplete_observations: NOT PRESENTED. The status is INSUFFICIENT_TAPE, INCONSISTENT_STATE or COLLECTOR_LAG and the candidate is excluded with its reason; it is never a zero vector

features.missing_is_not_zero: an unusable observation is not encoded at all. There is no stub returning zeros, because a modality or a measurement that returns zeros is indistinguishable from one that was never made.
features.no_manufactured_diversity: no random jitter, no ticker-dependent stimulation and no invented activity. Two tokens with equal raw vectors and different addresses produce equal rate vectors, and that is asserted by a test. Identical measured contexts are ALLOWED to encode identically; the requirement is to preserve the declared distinctions, not to make every token unique.
features.normalisation: tanh(raw / scale), fixed declared scales, never refitted during operation

scale_rules.age: fixed constant 600 s, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json (p90 of |x| on the first 60 minutes of d10-backfill-v1, rounded to two significant figures, computed there before any outcome existed)
scale_rules.since_last_trade: fixed constant 60 s, DECLARED by Fable addendum 4 and equal to maximum_seconds_since_last_trade, so an admitted token spans tanh(x/60) in (0, 0.76] and a held token that goes quiet keeps rising toward 1. It is not fitted to any sample.
scale_rules.ret_30s: fixed constant 0.0051, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json
scale_rules.ret_2m: fixed constant 0.11, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json
scale_rules.ret_5m: fixed constant 0.36, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json
scale_rules.flow_imb_2m: fixed constant 1.0, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json (the feature is bounded in [-1, 1] by construction)
scale_rules.trade_count_2m: FITTED BY RULE X, VALUE PENDING THE CALIBRATION COMMIT
scale_rules.gross_volume_2m: FITTED BY RULE X, VALUE PENDING THE CALIBRATION COMMIT
scale_rules.rv_2m: fixed constant 0.029, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json
scale_rules.drawdown_5m: fixed constant 0.51, carried unchanged from experiments/d10/config.json

features.rule_x: RULE X, registered here before it is computed: the scale of a fitted feature is p90 of |x| over the 30-second grid points of the tokens launched in the first 60 minutes of d10-backfill-v1 at which admission_v2 admits that token at that grid point, computed causally at each grid point with the tape truncated there, rounded to two significant figures. No outcome, no post-cutoff return, no PnL and no survival is computed anywhere in the fitting, and the fit is never repeated after a run is observed. The denominator is the admitted (token, grid point) pairs; its size is recorded in experiments/d11/feature_scales_v2.json.

trade_count_2m.rule: p90(|x|) over the admitted 30-second grid points, rounded to two significant figures (rule X)

gross_volume_2m.rule: p90(|x|) over the admitted 30-second grid points, rounded to two significant figures (rule X)

features.single_signed_note: five of the ten features never change sign, so one glomerulus of each of those pairs only ever receives the carrier. They keep the two-channel rule anyway, as D10 declared. rv_2m is a standard deviation and is non-negative by construction too, and is listed here as it was in D10: not declared single-signed, and in fact never negative.

encoder.olfactory: flytrade.encoder.MarketToSensoryEncoder, unchanged; the verified olfactory pathway, with no gain or decoder retune
encoder.input_schema_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON {"features": [the ordered feature names], "scales": {name: scale}, "channels": [the channel map rows]} with sorted keys and no whitespace. It cannot be computed until the two fitted scales exist, so it is written by the calibration commit together with them.
encoder.checkpoint_metadata: the checkpoint's metadata gains encoder_version and input_schema_sha256. Loading a checkpoint whose metadata carries a DIFFERENT schema hash for continued learning RAISES. The one exception is a run declared from_clean_reference whose checkpoint is the clean reference itself, which predates the field and is the only checkpoint allowed to lack it.

reinforcement.attributed_to: the entry decision's stored k=8 eligibility trace set, by episode id
reinforcement.mapping: valence is the sign of the settled net outcome and amount is min(|net_pnl / notional| / reinforce_full_scale, reinforce_cap) — flytrade.execution.ExecutionPolicy.reinforcement, mechanism unchanged. Only the full-scale parameter moves.
reinforcement.reinforce_full_scale_is_per_experiment: reinforce_full_scale becomes a per-experiment configuration parameter, read from this file by the Pons loop's execution policy. flytrade.execution.REINFORCE_FULL_SCALE stays 0.01, every D5-D10 code path stays byte-identical, and the IBM historical loop keeps reading its own config's 0.01.
reinforcement.calibration_rule:
q = 90th percentile of abs(net_return) over the calibration set, with linear interpolation.
new_full_scale = max(old_full_scale, 2 * q).
reinforcement.calibration_set_rule: The calibration set is the distinct, confirmed D10 LEARN outcomes that actually generated the reported learning updates: the eight LEARNING records that exist, namely d10-001/learning episodes 4000000, 36000009, 68000017, 100000022, 132000028, 165000109 and 203000217, and d10-live-001 episode 7000087. Excluded: the determinism re-run of d10-001/learning (the same events, not new ones, same normalised sha256 34a74b0b780e...); the eight SETTLED_FROZEN outcomes of d10-001/frozen_reference (no reinforcement was ever called); the pending live position d10-live-001 episode 72000315 (PENDING_CONFIRMATION, no exit leg, no settlement); and every estimated or unavailable settlement. net_return = net_pnl / notional with notional 0.01 ETH, read back from the OUTCOME records and re-derived from the leg integers published in experiments/d10/closure_complement.md; the two must agree.
reinforcement.same_scale_for_both_signs: the same scale is used for positive and negative outcomes. No average loss is subtracted, no cost is refunded through the reward, and a net loss is never converted into positive reinforcement.
reinforcement.frozen_for_the_next_experiment: the scale is frozen for the next experiment version. There is no rolling recalibration during operation, and the multiplier, the quantile and the scale are never tuned after observing a BUY frequency or a run's performance.
reinforcement.not_applied_to_old_checkpoints: the proposed rewards are NOT applied to any old checkpoint. D10's learned state stays exactly as it is.
reinforcement.coarse_engineering_reference: the calibration set is eight selected outcomes from one 15-minute-horizon window on one instrument class. It is a coarse engineering reference for a scale parameter and is not an estimate of the memecoin market's return distribution.

next_run.status: DECLARED, NOT RUN. It is the owner's next decision and D11 stops before it.
next_run.shape: one replay branch on data/pons/d10-backfill-v1 from the clean reference checkpoint, then one live hour, with an evaluation designed before the run
next_run.it_is_a_new_environment_experiment: d11-001 is an explicit new encoder/environment experiment under a new identity. It is NOT a silent erasure of D10's losses or learned state: d10-001 and d10-live-001 keep their identities, their logs, their checkpoints and their pending position, available for recovery under their original policy. The pending live position (d10-live-001, episode 72000315) is not cancelled, closed or migrated because the observation exercise ended.
next_run.a_combined_correction_cannot_attribute: admission, sensory context and the reinforcement scale change together. A later behavioural difference cannot be attributed to any one of them, and d11-001 must be reported as an integrated environment repair, never as isolated proof about one component.

success_is_not: a profit, a win rate or a BUY frequency
any comparison of d11-001 with d10-001, which ran a different environment

label.name: evaluator-only fixed-15-minute net outcome
label.definition: per grid row: a hypothetical buy of 10^16 wei at cutoff + 2 s through PonsPaperExecution.plan_buy on a FRESH execution object; the position's own reserve delta is carried exactly as the loop's settlement path carries it; the exit is plan_sell on the tape advanced by the recorded external events at entry_fill_block_timestamp + 900 s. net = quote_out - spent - gas_buy - gas_sell - approval with the D10 gas constants, computed by the same arithmetic ExecutionPolicy._settle uses. The label is POSITIVE iff net > 0.
label.unresolved: Unresolved (route transition, coverage) or QuoteError (exhausted curve) -> label UNRESOLVED, excluded from AUC and counted
it_never: touches the ledger or a checkpoint
label.known_answer_test_written_before_the_gri: the label function, run at the recorded cutoffs of the 16 settled D10 entries on d10-backfill-v1, reproduces each recorded net to the wei (|difference| < 1e-18 ETH).

run_config.spec: docs/SPEC.md, the D11-001 owner spec (2026-09-13), the owner's decision on the data (a NEW 12-hour backfill d11-backfill-v1 through the local Nitro node) and the thirteen Fable addenda
run_config.base_config: experiments/d11/config.json — admission_v2 constants, pons_context_v2 features and scales, pons_encoder_v2 input_schema_sha256, reinforcement.new_full_scale and the clean reference checkpoint are read from there and are NOT restated here

registration.rule: Fable addendum 2. This file and the PLAN.md section 7 are committed ALONE, before any request to any node, before the collection and before any D11-001 number exists. Step (iii) writes the window, the cutoff, the tick counts, the geometric ceiling, the grid row count and the label class balance — numbers only — and the brain runs only after step (iii).
registration.nothing_is_re_chosen_after_a_result: no threshold, window, hold, concurrency or scale moves after a result is observed. If something cannot be done as specified the deviation is declared in this plan, the report and HANDOFF; nothing is absorbed silently.

fixed_for_the_whole_wave.decoder: the stored k = 8 decoder, baseline -0.844389816810345 Hz, theta 0.9117185769796697 Hz
fixed_for_the_whole_wave.k_means_the_readout_replicate_count: the owner's 'k=8' is the number of readout replicates per candidate evaluation. Candidates per round stay 6.
fixed_for_the_whole_wave.forgetting: the Pons loop never calls mb.forget(); 'disable learning and forgetting' is satisfied by FROZEN mode, and a test asserts each frozen branch's end digest equals its start digest.

layout.dataset: data/pons/d11-backfill-v1/  (events.jsonl, headers.jsonl, raw.jsonl, discovery.json, initial_states.json, cursor.json, MANIFEST.json) — the D10 store layout
layout.initial_states_are_mandatory: the offline tracker needs initial_states.json for exact reconstruction; a store without it is refused
layout.d10_is_untouched: experiments/d10/, data/pons/d10-backfill-v1/, data/market, upstream, tests/upstream_audit, experiments/d7, d8, d9b and experiments/historical/runs do not change in this wave; d10-backfill-v1 stays as the historical baseline.

node.rule: 127.0.0.1 only. No socket is ever opened to anything else. The stockroom .env is neither read nor written in this wave.
discovery_order: then the loopback host ports published by a local container whose image identifies a Nitro node, ascending — read from the local container list, which sends no request to any node
then any other loopback port served by a local Ethereum node process already running (e.g. anvil), ascending
node.discovery_deviation_declared_before_the_: addendum 3 names 8547 then 8545. Those two are probed first and in that order. The extension to the published loopback ports of a local Nitro container and to other local node processes is a DECLARED widening of the port list, registered here BEFORE the first request, because the owner's decision put discovery in the agent's hands ('Agente descobre sozinho') and told it to verify the endpoint rather than assume a port. The VERIFICATION rule is not widened at all.
node.never_probed: no JSON-RPC request is sent to a loopback port that is not served by an Ethereum node process — a database, a cache, a browser or an editor port is never posted to.
node.verification: a candidate is verified only if eth_chainId returns 4663 AND the timestamp of its `latest` block is within 300 s of wall clock. The first verified candidate in the order above is used and every port probed is reported with what it answered.
node.endpoint_file: experiments/d11/local_node.env, key LOCAL_NITRO_RPC_HTTP, passed through the existing --env-file/--env-key path. A loopback URL is not a secret and is committed.
probe_contents: eth_chainId and eth_getBlockByNumber('latest') per candidate port
eth_blockNumber and eth_getBlockByNumber('safe') on the chosen endpoint
eth_getBlockByNumber at the block about 12 h back, with a bounded refinement
one eth_getLogs over one collector-sized chunk (1,000 blocks, factory filter) at the old end of the window
one eth_call creatorTaxBps() at an old block — the only kind of historical eth_call the D10 backfill and the live driver make
node.no_fallback: if any of those fails, or needs state the local node does not hold, the wave STOPS with the exact list (method, block, purpose, count) and its Chainstack cost in units. Chainstack is used only after the owner authorises that list. There is no automatic fallback and --allow-remote is never passed.

budget.classification: flytrade.pons.budget classifies an endpoint by host: 127.0.0.1, localhost and ::1 are LOOPBACK, everything else is REMOTE.
budget.loopback_ledger: experiments/d11/rpc_ledger_local.json — its own file, its own counters, independent of experiments/d10/rpc_ledger.json
budget.chainstack_unchanged: the Chainstack caps (wave 10,000 / run 5,000 / day 10,000), its ledger and its accounting do not move in this wave
budget.remote_is_refused: a ledger opened in loopback scope refuses a non-loopback endpoint with RPC_REMOTE_REFUSED before the socket opens, unless --allow-remote is passed. The agent never passes it, and the report states the remote request count, which must be 0.

projection.rule: three times the projected request count of the 12-hour collection, from the collector's chunking and the D10 MANIFEST per-method counts scaled by block count
arithmetic: blocks = 43,200 s / 0.101 s per block (the D10 measured median interval) = 427,723
grid headers, one per HEADER_GRID_BLOCKS = 100 plus two: 427,723 / 100 + 2 = 4,279  (D10: 331 eth_getBlockByNumber over 33,198 blocks of the resumed segment = 9.97 per 1,000 blocks)
factory eth_getLogs, one per FACTORY_CHUNK_BLOCKS = 1,000 segment: 428

curve eth_getLogs: 428 segments x ceil(tracked/250) address batches x ceil(1000/500) chunks. D10 measured 3.94 curve requests per segment at ~440 native launches tracked per hour; projected at 6 per segment to leave room for a larger tracked set: 2,568
eth_call creatorTaxBps fallback: D10 needed 3 in 991 launches; scaled to ~5,300 launches and rounded up: 20
eth_chainId / eth_blockNumber / latest and safe headers: 10
projection.cap_rule: 3 x 7,400 = 22,200, registered here before the first request and not raised afterwards
projection.if_the_cap_is_reached: the collection stops there with its cursor and ledger on disk and the report says so. The cap is not raised after seeing a result.

window.rule: 12 contiguous hours ending at the confirmed head at probe time. end_block = the confirmed block, which is min(head - confirm_depth, safe) with the collector's own confirmation definition (confirm_depth measured at probe time from the local node, safe used when the endpoint answers the tag). start_block = the smallest block whose timestamp is >= timestamp(end_block) - 43,200.
window.no_overlap: the window must not overlap d10-backfill-v1 (2026-09-12T01:37:36Z - 2026-09-12T03:53:25Z, blocks 60721229-60801426). If it would, the end is moved earlier until it does not. A test asserts the disjointness on the written MANIFEST.

also_records: sha256 and byte size of every file

window.collected_once: the store is collected once and persisted. Every later step reads the store; no later step opens a socket, and a test parses run.py, grid.py and evaluate.py for network verbs and for flytrade.pons.rpc, as D11 already does for its own scripts.
window.tick_grid: 30-second ticks anchored at t0 = timestamp(start_block). Every partition, every replay branch and the evaluation grid use this one grid, so a cutoff is the same instant everywhere.

split.rule: t0 = timestamp(start_block), t1 = timestamp(end_block). T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)), snapped DOWN to the 30-second tick grid anchored at t0.
split.computed_from_timestamps_only: T is computed before any outcome, any label and any neural number, and is recorded in step (iii).

learning_partition.entry_rule: an entry is allowed only if cutoff + latency + horizon = cutoff + 902 <= T
learning_partition.boundary_ticks: ticks in (T - 902, T] observe, mark and settle, and never enter
learning_partition.assertion: the run fails if a learning position is open at T

frozen_partition.market_state: the frozen loop branches rebuild the market from t0 without the brain: the first frozen tick ingests every event at or before T, and the brain evaluates nothing before T

split.temporal_blocks: three blocks of equal duration over the FROZEN grid span [first frozen cutoff, last frozen cutoff]; a row belongs to the block its cutoff falls in, the last block closed at the right
split.geometric_ceiling: the number of non-overlapping 932-second slots (902 s of latency+horizon plus one 30-second tick) between the first LEARNING tick that has at least one v2-eligible candidate and T - 902

learning_run.starts_from: the clean reference checkpoint under from_clean_reference
learning_run.records: as D10 writes them — ROUND (every presented candidate's score), DECISION, EXECUTION, OUTCOME, LEARNING, CHECKPOINT — and each LEARNING record additionally carries the raw net outcome, the normalised amount, the full scale it was divided by and a clipped flag (amount == cap)
learning_run.final_checkpoint: TRAINED; its digest is recorded in the run summary and in the grid manifest
learning_run.one_brain: one learned brain is carried across tokens for the whole partition

grid.what_it_is: a market-only scoring pass, not the loop. Presentation inside the loop depends on run state — while a position is held only the held token is presented, and the round-robin advances with evaluated rounds — so two frozen loop branches cannot share rows. The grid is therefore built from the store alone.
construction: for every FROZEN tick, reconstruct the tape of every tracked token from the store alone (the retrospective tracker, exact with initial_states.json)
apply admission_v2 at that cutoff and take ALL eligible candidates: no cap of 6, no rotation, no hold mode. This is a superset of anything either loop branch could have presented.

score each candidate with BOTH frozen brains using the standard readout: k = 8 replicates under comparison_v1, seeds from (observation_id, stable_id, replicate index) and independent of the checkpoint digest
grid.rows: keyed by (cutoff_ts, stable_id), identical across branches by construction
per_row_and_branch: decoded action at the k = 8 thresholds
grid.coverage: rows VALID in both branches / rows
grid.read_only: both frozen brains are loaded read-only and their digests are verified before and after the pass. No execution, no bankroll, no reinforcement and no checkpoint write happens in the grid.

statistics.primary: dAUC = AUC(TRAINED) - AUC(REFERENCE), over rows VALID in both branches that carry a settled label
statistics.auc: Mann-Whitney U / (n_pos * n_neg), ties counted one half

uncertainty.method: paired cluster bootstrap by stable_id — a token's rows move together

statistics.wording_rule: an interval that includes 0 is reported as 'compatible with sampling variation'; one that does not is reported with its bounds. Never 'significant', never 'proves', no rate asserted as measured. An AUC near 0.5 is not evidence that no signal exists.
secondary_descriptive: Spearman(score, net) per branch and their difference
the distribution of the per-row score difference TRAINED - REFERENCE

suppression.on_the_grid: BUY-crossing rate (valence > theta) per branch, overall, per block and by later outcome class
suppression.preregistered_reading: the between-class difference of the trained-minus-reference change, with the same clustered interval: 'global' if that interval includes 0, 'contextual' if it excludes 0 with the larger drop in the negative class. Nothing else is said in words.

known_answer_tests: AUC 1, 0 and 0.5 on perfect, reversed and constant toy data

saturation.definition: computed offline from the logged normalised vectors u = tanh(raw / scale). flytrade.encoder.MarketToSensoryEncoder.weights clips u to [-1, 1] (flytrade/encoder.py:228) and never logs that it did, so saturation is read off the vector: a channel is SATURATED when |u| >= 1 - 1e-12, which is where the clip bites and where float64 tanh has already reached 1.0 (|raw/scale| >~ 19.06).
reported: the fraction of (row, channel) pairs saturated
the fraction of rows with at least one saturated channel

verbatim_from_the_owner: fewer than 100 paired FROZEN candidate labels
either positive or negative outcome class has fewer than 20 labeled examples
material encoder saturation or invalid-state rate above 5%

operationalised.completed_LEARNING_episodes: settled episodes that produced a LEARNING record in the learning branch
operationalised.paired_FROZEN_candidate_labels: grid rows VALID in both branches with a settled (non-UNRESOLVED) label
operationalised.class_counts: positive = net > 0, negative = net <= 0, over the paired labelled rows
operationalised.paired_neural_coverage: rows VALID in both branches / all grid rows
operationalised.saturation_and_invalid_state: the (row, channel) saturated fraction > 5 %, or the INVALID_STATE rate on the grid > 5 %

inconclusive_conditions.do_not_loosen: these thresholds are not loosened after the run. Three of them are pre-computable and are checked in step (iii): fewer than 100 settled grid labels, fewer than 20 in either class, or a geometric ceiling under 20 ends the wave with a report and no neural run.

frozen_loop_branches.what_they_are: two FROZEN replays over the FROZEN partition — frozen_trained and frozen_reference — with paper trading, as D10's frozen_reference ran: SETTLED_FROZEN settlements, no LEARNING record, end digest equal to start digest
frozen_loop_branches.they_are_descriptive: their PnL, action frequencies and holding durations are the FROZEN 'paper results'. They are NOT the primary comparison and they do not decide which observations the grid contains.

live_hour.when: only after the replay report is written
live_hour.learning: LEARN — the declared d11-001 live branch keeps learning enabled
live_hour.starts_from: the TRAINED checkpoint; its state digest is verified on disk and recorded as starts_from_digest
live_hour.endpoint: the same local node under the loopback ledger, with the chainId gate (4663) and the 120-second freshness rule
live_hour.if_not_fresh_at_start: the live hour is NOT started and that is reported. It is not worked around.
live_hour.no_tuning: the same configuration, no parameter changes between replay and live, and the two are reported separately
live_hour.no_real_money: paper only. No signing, no funds, no broadcast; the RPC method allowlist carries no signing method.

observer.root: a D11 root is added to observer/serve.py ROOTS and the observer is restarted on localhost:8793
observer.a_finished_run_is_a_record: a finished run is labelled a record of an hour that already ended, never a fly operating now

success_is_not: a profit, a win rate or a BUY frequency
any comparison of d11-001 with d10-001, which ran a different environment and a different window
run_config.an_integrated_environment_repair: admission, sensory context and the reinforcement scale moved together in D11. A behavioural difference between TRAINED and REFERENCE here is a difference between one brain that saw 8.4 hours of this environment and one that saw none; it can never be attributed to any one of the three D11 changes.

baseline.distribution: the k-presentation aggregate raw valence V_raw = mean(approach) - mean(avoid) at the neutral reference, one sample per BATCH, sample standard deviation with ddof=1 - never the standard error of that mean

encoder.input_schema_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON {"features": [ordered names], "scales": {name: scale}, "channels": [channel map]} with sorted keys and no whitespace

readout.aggregation: mean of per-neuron rates, decoder applied once
readout.why: amendment section 6: the stimulus realisation must not change because the weights differ

split.rule: t0 = timestamp(start_block), t1 = timestamp(end_block), T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)) snapped down to the 30-second tick grid anchored at t0
split.learning_entry_rule: an entry is allowed only if cutoff + 902 <= T

execution_policy.gas_source: donor calibration medians over 40 buy and 40 sell receipts; the approval leg is a 60,000-gas assumption at the same gas price, not a receipt
execution_policy.cost_model: curve base fee + creator tax + decaying snipe tax into `fees` with the gas; price impact into `slippage` as the gap between the pre-trade marginal price and the achieved price

rules: deployment is the supported pons-v2 curve route
quote asset is native ETH
age >= 60 s and the reconstructed tape answers at the cutoff
curve not completed at the cutoff
sellableTokens > 0 and realQuoteReserve > 0
the paper buy of size_wei would not exhaust the curve
cutoff + latency + horizon lies inside the token's coverage
at least minimum_valid_trades_in_window valid trades inside (cutoff - recent_window_seconds, cutoff]
the last valid trade at most maximum_seconds_since_last_trade before the cutoff
admission_policy.valid_trade: CurveBuy or CurveSell with a nonzero quote leg and a nonzero token leg, deduplicated by log id; buys and sells count the same; creation, liquidity configuration, completion and duplicated logs are not trades
admission_policy.removed_from_v1: the '>= 3 trades ever' clause of pons_context_v1
admission_policy.rotation: round-robin: rounds since last presentation descending, then launch block, then launch log index, then curve address; blind to price, volume, flow and outcome
admission_policy.reversible: recomputed fresh at every tick; an inactive candidate returns on new qualifying activity

unresolved.detail: the window ended with the position still open
